import json
from pathlib import Path
from modelanvil.runners.cpu_character_eval_envelope import measured_spread, check_run, load_policy, load_reference
reports = []
for n in (1, 2, 3):
    record = json.loads(Path(f"/tmp/anvil021/repeats2/repeat-{n}.json").read_text())
    reports.append(json.loads(record["stdout"]))
policy = load_policy()
reference = load_reference()
spread = measured_spread(reports)
checks = [check_run(policy, reference, reports, item) for item in reports]
print(json.dumps({
    "policy_id": policy["id"],
    "repeat_sha": json.loads(Path("/tmp/anvil021/repeats2/repeat-1.json").read_text())["sha"],
    "exact_disagreements": spread["exact_disagreements"],
    "tolerances": spread["tolerances"],
    "checks_ok": [item["ok"] for item in checks],
    "wall_seconds": [item["wall_seconds"] for item in reports],
    "candidate_output": reports[0]["cases"][0]["candidate_output"],
    "baseline_output": reports[0]["cases"][0]["baseline_output"],
    "candidate_weights_sha256": reports[0]["candidate_weights_sha256"],
    "baseline_weights_sha256": reports[0]["baseline_weights_sha256"],
    "score": reports[0]["cases"][0]["score"],
    "passed": reports[0]["cases"][0]["passed"],
    "accuracy_value": reports[0]["metrics"][0]["value"],
    "accuracy_upper": reports[0]["metrics"][0]["uncertainty"]["upper"],
}, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
'
